Return ONE complete high-resolution landscape website screenshot, with only those four image regions edited, no browser chrome, watermark, outside scenery, or presentation mockup.
PICTURE STYLE FOR ALL FOUR REGIONS: strongly flat, hand-drawn poster-like neobrutalist food illustrations, absolutely NOT photography, 3D rendering, glossy realism or a photo filter. Use only yellow, warm cream, solid black and restrained orange. Bold sharp black outlines, flat duotone or limited-color fills, hard graphic black shadows, squared cutout geometry, crisp illustrative details. The three menu pictures become separately drawn flat outlined illustrations of the SAME coffee cup, croissant and tea glass, with the same placement and sizes. All four must be unmistakably illustrated and visually coordinated with the yellow/cream/black/orange website. Preserve every existing yellow gutter, cream panel, thick black UI border, hard UI shadow, typeface, button, caption and word exactly unchanged. No extra doodles, captions, food, patterns or outlines outside the existing picture regions.
